title: aeluropus littoralis var. micrantherus
intro: Aeluropus littoralis var. micrantherus, commonly known as Smaller Spiked Salt Grass, is a variant of the Aeluropus littoralis plant, belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Smaller Spiked Salt Grass include its use in treating gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, as well as its potential application in managing fever and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
